records.text: Laine Schoneberger's onstage thanks to Erika Kirk signaled to Candace Owens that Kirk was just offstage at the event.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And it looks certainly like he acknowledges Erika (Erika Kirk) on stage and looks to the left. He says her name and he says like, thank you, Erika (Erika Kirk). ... So Erika (Erika Kirk), thank you. Thank you for your friendship and believing in Yrefy. ... I'm telling you, I am with Baron (Baron Coleman) on this. She was in the building and she was backstage where people could not see her.

verification.notes: The primary episode records Laine Schoneberger thanking Erika Kirk and immediately records Candace Owens saying that the gesture signaled to her that Kirk was offstage. This verifies Owens interpretation, not whether Kirk was actually backstage.
